id: bigtech:binance ceo says 90 percent of stolen assets have been reple:2026-10-31T18:40:32.000Z
title: Binance CEO says 90 percent of stolen assets have been ‘replenished’
author: Terrence O’Brien
summary_long: After hackers stole a shocking $6.3 billion from Binance customers in a record-breaking crypto heist, the company's CEO says that 90 percent of the funds have been replaced, and the company plans to cover the remaining 10 percent as well. Binance is covering the stolen funds directly, and the remaining 10 percent consists of "less liquid" tokens, which the company says may take longer to acquire. The company also said in a post on X that, while withdrawals remain paused, they're on track to be enabled on Sunday. > Our commitment remains the same: Binance will fully cover the financial impact of the funds stolen in this incident. id: nextfrontiers:electrolyte redesign unlocks tins full charge capacity for f:2026-10-31T17:10:01.000Z
title: Electrolyte redesign unlocks tin's full charge capacity for flow batteries
summary_long: Tin is able to exchange four electrons as it changes between dissolved ions and solid metal, but acidic tin batteries commonly use only a two-electron reaction, leaving half that potential charge out of reach. Now, researchers in China have shown that changing the liquid around the tin could capture that extra capacity. Source: techxplore.com. Date: 2026-10-31.
